MuBRI0lcHfMKHshy.name: Skills
MuBRI0lcHfMKHshy.description: Choose any two skills from the Magic or Knowledge skill groups. Skip your specialization skill (Pyromancer: Spellcraft, Stormcaller: Perception, Geomancer: Athletics); it’s granted separately. (Quick Build: Occult, Rituals.)

eOPi50E6A0VUJF5S.name: Kit (Optional)
eOPi50E6A0VUJF5S.description: You can take one light magic/tech Kit — Hexshot (ranged caster), Spellblade (melee-adjacent), or Sanctified — whose magic damage rider reskins as elemental essence. A pure artillery Elementalist picks No Kit (Pure Caster), which grants nothing, and lets their signature focus do the work of a weapon. (Quick Build: No Kit.)

fGim06njgAUYAvMx.name: Elementalist Specialization
fGim06njgAUYAvMx.description:
Choose your element cluster: Pyromancer (fire, the blaster), Stormcaller (air and water, the battlefield mover), or Geomancer (earth and void, the fortress). Each grants a skill, a signature summon, and a signature focus. (Quick Build: Pyromancer.)

Cyborgs can’t be Elementalists (Arcane Severance).

WeSp6ZyUFGtsolRb.name: Signature Abilities
WeSp6ZyUFGtsolRb.description: You know all three Elementalist signature abilities: Hurl Element, Elemental Shaping, and Read the Weave. None of them costs Essence; spending Essence boosts them.
